run_sbatch_experiment: run a single experiment with multiple moolib peers using sbatch on a Slurm cluster
run_sbatch_dry: run the sbatch experiment script in dry mode to preview the command without submitting
get_address: get the broker address from SSH connection env var or fall back to the local hostname
check_nfs: check if the current working directory is mounted on an NFS filesystem using statfs
check_broker_online: check if the moolib broker is online by connecting and sending a sync RPC call
